Nearby Interactions-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

UWB proximity marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general AirDrop or Handoff guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Nearby Interactions permission claims:

附近交互 vs 附近交互权限 vs 超宽带

US pages say "Nearby Interactions", "Grant Nearby Interactions access", or "Enable UWB proximity in System Settings." Apple's official Simplified Chinese Settings label is 附近交互 under 隐私与安全性. China storefront copy often uses 附近交互 for general Nearby Interactions positioning aligned with Settings → Privacy & Security → Nearby Interactions, 附近交互权限 when the hero frame shows the permission rationale or access scope, and 超宽带 when English source names UWB or Ultra Wideband on accessory or ranging buyer frames. AppLocale picks commerce-idiomatic phrasing per frame — not 隔空投送 on consumer Nearby Interactions screenshots, not 接力 on UWB grant walkthroughs, and not 本地网络 on proximity permission onboarding.

Nearby Interactions vs AirDrop

Consumer Nearby Interactions (附近交互) lets end users toggle per-app access to UWB proximity and the Nearby Interaction framework in System Settings after consent. AirDrop (隔空投送) is wireless file send to nearby Apple devices — a different sharing control story. English shares "nearby" phrasing — Chinese storefront copy must not conflate consumer 附近交互 permission panels with 隔空投送 file-transfer marketing. AirDrop frames belong on the AirDrop listing guide when wireless file send leads — not mixed into Nearby Interactions captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Nearby Interactions vs Handoff

Consumer Nearby Interactions (附近交互) governs UWB direction-and-distance sensing via the Nearby Interaction framework. Handoff (接力) governs Continuity session resume across Apple devices. Proximity API permission is not start-on-iPhone-continue-on-Mac marketing. Handoff frames belong on the Handoff listing guide when cross-device task resume leads — not mixed into Nearby Interactions captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Nearby Interactions vs Local Network and Bluetooth

Nearby Interactions permission governs UWB proximity sessions — 附近交互. Local Network permission governs LAN device discovery on the same Wi-Fi — 本地网络. Bluetooth permission governs Bluetooth hardware access — 蓝牙. A Nearby Interactions grant toggle is not a Bonjour browse rationale and not a Bluetooth pairing sheet unless that is what the frame shows. Local Network frames belong on the Local Network listing guide when LAN discovery leads.

Nearby Interactions vs Control Nearby Devices and NameDrop

Nearby Interactions (附近交互) governs developer UWB proximity API access. Control Nearby Devices (控制附近的设备) governs Accessibility remote navigation of another Apple device on the same Wi-Fi. NameDrop (名片投送) governs system proximity contact-card exchange. Different buyer stories with different zh-Hans terms. Control Nearby Devices frames belong on the Control Nearby Devices listing guide; NameDrop frames belong on the NameDrop listing guide when those features lead.

How is Nearby Interactions different from Local Network and Control Nearby Devices?

Nearby Interactions covers permission to use UWB proximity and the Nearby Interaction framework after user grants nearby-interaction access — 附近交互. Local Network covers LAN device discovery on the same Wi-Fi — 本地网络. Control Nearby Devices covers Accessibility remote navigation of another Apple device — 控制附近的设备. UWB developer permission is not LAN Bonjour browse and not Accessibility remote unless that is what the frame shows.

Which zh-Hans terms should Nearby Interactions listing copy use?

It depends on each frame. 附近交互 for general Nearby Interactions positioning aligned with Settings → Privacy & Security → Nearby Interactions — Apple's official zh-Hans Settings label. 附近交互权限 for permission rationale and access scope frames. 超宽带 for UWB or Ultra Wideband phrasing on ranging or accessory frames. AppLocale picks idiomatic phrasing from your English source — not 隔空投送 on consumer Nearby Interactions overlays, not 接力 on UWB grant walkthroughs, and not 本地网络 on proximity permission onboarding.
